title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: Replacement of the thirty Mo2 linker units in a Mo-based Keplerate offers a route to a related sphere with Fe(III)-based linkers while retaining the pentagonal-unit framework.
explanation: The review reports that reaction of cluster 16 with FeCl3 fully replaces its Mo2 dumbbells with Fe(III)(H2O) polyhedra, each bridging octahedra belonging to different pentagonal units.
scope: The specific Mo-based Keplerate transformation from cluster 16 to cluster 17.
caveats: This is a demonstrated transformation in one system, not evidence that arbitrary linker substitution will preserve a Keplerate.
